subject: yc-safe-postmoney
citation: The Y Combinator post-money safe (Simple Agreement for Future Equity): six instruments — three economic variants for the United States and one each for Singapore, Canada and the Cayman Islands — plus four Pro Rata Side Letters, published by Y Combinator Management, LLC at https://www.ycombinator.com/documents under a Creative Commons Attribution-NoDerivatives 4.0 International licence.
in_force_absent_reason: A standard form has no in-force date and no publisher's currency banner, because nothing enacted it and nothing commences it; it has EDITIONS, and an edition is a publication event, not a period of legal force. The publisher's own instruction on how to tell which edition you hold is a version stamp on the page, not a banner: SAFE User Guide, Appendix III — "Version numbers are stamped on the upper right-hand corner of each form of the post-money safe." Those stamps were extracted from the .docx headers and are recorded per file in subject.json (forms[].version_stamp) and source/footers.json. No in-force date is asserted here because none exists to assert; this is a source that states none, which the schema distinguishes from a source we merely did not check.
note:
Six things a reader has to know that the schema has no field for.

(1) THE SCHEMA IS STATUTE-SHAPED AND THIS SUBJECT IS NOT A STATUTE. Two of its required sweeps have no referent for a published contract form, and both are answered with a stated reason rather than an invented value: `in_force_absent_reason` above, and a `covers_absent_reason` on every document. NOTES.md §"What the schema asked that a form cannot answer" names each rule that fired.

(2) NO DOCUMENT CARRIES ROLE 'instrument'. That role is for the text a subject is MADE UNDER — an enabling statute, a parent Act. A privately published contract form is made under nothing, so naming one would be a fabrication. The ten forms are 'current' because they are the publisher's live text as at retrieval; the User Guide is 'guidance' on the same reasoning as the us/chubb-hospital-cash bundle uses for an answer key — it is the issuing body's own non-binding reading of its own instrument, published alongside it.

(3) THE ANNOTATION INVENTORY IS EMPTY, AND THAT IS A FINDING. There is no publisher apparatus over a .docx: no textual-amendment markers, no modification list, no commencement or extent notes, no editorial footnotes. Every document therefore carries "annotations": [] — an explicit empty sweep rather than an absent key. As in the chubb bundle, "the inventory is complete and it is empty" is unrepresentable, because an annotation_group requires markers with minItems 1; the sentence has to live here.

(4) THERE IS NO `assembled` ARTIFACT, DELIBERATELY. `assembled` names the one provenance-headed file an encoding is written from. This subject has ten source documents and no single assembled text; the derived layer is source/md/, one Markdown file per .docx, and those are DERIVATIONS rather than retrievals, so they are not listed as documents. They are reproducible: `pandoc <file>.docx -t gfm --wrap=none` under pandoc 2.9.2.1 regenerates all fourteen deposited .md files byte-for-byte (checked 2026-09-04). Every deposited file, source and derived, is digested in source/SHA256SUMS.

(5) THE MARKDOWN LOSES THE LICENCE. pandoc drops headers and footers entirely, and the CC BY-ND notice and the version stamp live only there. source/footers.json is the repair: it carries every header and footer string, per file, reconstructed from the OOXML runs. Anything that reproduces a form from source/md/ must put the footer back, because attribution is a condition of the grant and not a courtesy.

(6) NO retrieval_cost IS RECORDED. The fetch that produced these bytes did not measure itself. Every URL and digest here WAS independently re-verified on 2026-09-04 by re-fetching all eleven assets and comparing sha256 against the deposited copy — all eleven matched, from both https://www.ycombinator.com/assets/ycdc/ and the //bookface-static.ycombinator.com host the page actually links — but that verification is not what the field means, and a fabricated zero would be worse than the silence.

documents.covers_absent_reason: A standard form states no range of law. It carries an EDITION — a version number stamped in the upper right-hand corner, which is where the User Guide says to look — and an edition is not a period during which anything was in force. The publisher's changelog gives release dates but the instrument itself gives none, and writing a range here would invent a currency the document does not claim. The edition each file bears is recorded in subject.json (forms[].version_stamp) and measured in source/footers.json.
